描述_ZN: Black glaze carved jade vase, Song dynasty, 21 cm high, 6.5 cm in diameter, 7.5 cm in foot.　　The vase has a skewed mouth, a thin neck, a rounded, drooping belly, and a rounded footrim. The whole body is covered with black glaze, the outer bottom is unglazed, and the middle of the belly is unglazed for a week, on which two weeks of water waves are carved.　　Song dynasty porcelain is mostly beautiful, simple and generous, both practical and high ornamental, this bottle is an example. In terms of decoration, a week of light-colored decorative bands are revealed on the dark-colored ware, which is quite eye-catching.　　In the Tang Dynasty, Si Kongtu's "Poetry - Elegance" has the phrase "jade jug for spring, enjoying the rain and loess huts; a good man in the seat, cultivating bamboo around". The jade pot spring vase was shaped in the Song Dynasty, and then gradually transformed into a decorative vessel. It is a typical piece of Chinese porcelain.
